sources.snippet: We introduce Hibiki, a decoder-only model for simultaneous speech translation. sources.title: High-Fidelity Simultaneous Speech-To-Speech Translation
sources.snippet: Abstract We introduce Hibiki, a decoder-only model for simultaneous speech translation. Hibiki leverages a multistream language model to synchronously process source and target speech, and jointly produces text and audio tokens to perform speech-to-text and speech-to-speech translation.
